body.x: Samsung Electronics, Korea's leading electronics company, held a press conference that grabbed the attention from hundreds of reporters at the CES 2015 press conference held on Jan. 5.

Samsung Electronics said it is in process of establishing a UHD Alliance by joint venturing with major TV manufacturers, Hollywood film companies, and content providers to raise the bar of UHD experience.

It also announced that it had the best year with the release of super premium home appliances like "Water Wall Dishwasher" that was created with the collaboration with some of the world's major chefs called "Chef Collection".
Held in every January, CES(Consumer Electronic Show) is the world's largest IT and consumer electronics exhibition to see the latest global trends in consumer electronics industry in one spot.

Globally recognized for its record in the number of published articles for CES, AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES every year to deliver the fastest and freshest news on the spot. This year, AVING News is using smartphones for news reporting, in line with the trend of one-person media.
